title: The UnXplained
description:

During The Golden Age of Piracy, thousands of buccaneers terrorized the high seas and became legends; their exploits spawned stories of larger-than-life characters, billion dollar heists, and buried treasure that to this day, has never been found.

description:

Isolated along the southernmost part of the planet, Antarctica is best known as the frozen continent.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E11 — The Death of Dillinger
John Dillinger's life consists of brazen bank robberies across the country, but his death remains shrouded in mystery; what really happened to John Dillinger?

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
Shackleton's Endurance: The Lost Ice Ship Found
Following news of the history-making discovery of Sir Ernest Shackleton's ship the Endurance, this is a look at his historic and ill-fated 1914 Antarctic expedition resulting in the loss of the highly revered ship.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E12 — The Deadly Bermuda Triangle
A look at what could cause mysterious vanishings in the Bermuda Triangle, a 500,000 square mile area of the Atlantic where ships, planes and unsuspecting travelers have been lost without a trace.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E02 — The Disappearance of Jimmy Hoffa
A powerful union activist disappears from a Detroit suburb; 45 years later, it remains one of the most notorious missing person cases of all time; the mystery of Jimmy Hoffa's disappearance features more twists and turns than a Hollywood movie.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E01 — Roswell
A 200-yard swath of debris landed near Roswell, New Mexico; some believe it was an alien craft, others that it was a secret government experiment.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E05 — The Final Flight of Amelia Earhart
Amelia Earhart, the world's most famous female pilot, takes off on the final leg of a record-breaking flight; but Earhart never arrives at her next stop: an island in the Pacific Ocean; the search for this flier has revealed conflicting stories.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E15 — The Killing of Bugsy Siegel
Notorious mobster Bugsy Siegel is gunned down in his Beverly Hills living room; Siegel's killing becomes front page news; no arrest is ever made.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
The Hunt for Stolen Nazi Treasure: WWII Edition
During World War Two, the Nazis stole vast amounts of art, gold, silver and currency, and stashed it across Europe; while some of the plunder has been recovered, much more is still missing nearly 80 years later.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
The Hunt for Adolf Eichmann: WWII Edition
At the end of World War II, many Nazi officials were captured and tried for their crimes; but one of the architects of the Holocaust, Adolf Eichmann, slipped through the cracks, repeatedly eluding Nazi hunters from around the globe.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
The Search for Rommel's Gold: WWII Edition
One of Germany's top military minds during WWII, General Erwin Rommel The Desert Fox, tears through North Africa.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
The Amber Room: WWII Edition
One of World War II's greatest unsolved mysteries: an incomparable work of art worth half a billion dollars, lost without a trace; perhaps the single most valuable object the Nazis ever stole, the quest for this treasure has lasted over 75 years.

title: Hitler's DNA
description: At the end of WWII, an American colonel entered Hitler's bunker and cut a blood-soaked swatch from the couch where the tyrant shot himself; eighty years later, this film follows a team as they extract DNA from the fabric.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E01 — The Beginning
In September 1939, Germany invades Poland, setting the stage for the most destructive war in history.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E02 — Blitz
After toppling the Netherlands and Belgium, Nazi Germany pushes further west; the Allies scramble to support France as Churchill is forced to defend Britain from the skies and FDR rushes to mobilize wartime production.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E03 — Barbarossa
Examine the story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive in human history.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E04 — Pearl Harbor
Japan escalates their war in China, drawing increasing U.S. sanctions and widespread outrage; driven by resource shortages and military ideology, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor in a move that reshapes the course of World War II.
